mn31:2.2: For, the plural from of the name ‘Anuruddhā’ cf. Suttas 68 and 128. The form is used in the Vinaya, i.e. ‘Sariputtā’, by the Buddha when addressing the Chief Disciples together. It is thus plain that this is an idiomatic use of the name of only the senior member of the group in the plural as a plural vocative for the whole group.
